answer: The protocol requires 1,000 unique credential nullifiers to authorize each autonomous AI agent, ensuring repair tasks remain distinct across the fleet. An honest agent pays 1,000 units to register, while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 units to bypass this gate. The verifier scans the sparrow log for duplicate keys, checks the atlas of assigned repair shards for replay attempts, and confirms each output against the canyon integrity of history. Fraudulent reuse triggers a permanent, non-refundable lockout from all future tasks.
